Product Features

  • The size fits perfectly: thanks to its slim profile of 120 x 24 x 200 cm, it fits perfectly into the door opening. The 24 cm thickness does not obstruct the passage, and the 200 cm height maximises the vertical space in the entrance area, so it can be easily extended even for small entrance areas.
  • Practical hooks: Eight hooks are arranged in several levels, so you can hang coats, bags and headphones as soon as you enter the house. This eliminates the need to spread your belongings on the sofa and the entrance area immediately looks tidier.
  • Clever page design: The site offers four small storage areas, ideal for keys and access cards. With picture frames and small plants, it becomes a decorative corner in the entrance area that combines functionality and aesthetics.
  • Shoe storage: Six downward-opening shoe cabinets, each with two shelves, offer space for two pairs of frequently worn shoes. This allows the shoes of the whole family to be neatly stowed away, which makes everyday life easier and makes shoe boxes lying around superfluous.
  • Large central storage area: On the large central storage area, you can easily place temporary parcels or carrier bags, or even display a bouquet of flowers, making it the "centerpiece" of the entrance area, maximizing its flexibility.
  • Durable Material: The chipboard is sturdy and durable, the white surface is stain-resistant and easy to clean. It is resistant to wear and tear caused by frequent opening and closing of cupboard doors and the loading and unloading of objects in the entrance area and remains clean and tidy for a long time.
  • Details of the folding door: Thanks to the folding door, you no longer have to bend down or squat. So you can easily fold up and remove your shoes. This makes putting on and taking off shoes much more comfortable and is particularly user-friendly for older people and pregnant women in advanced stages.
  • Versatile style: Pure white is a perfect match for modern minimalist, Scandinavian and Instagram-inspired living styles. Placed in the entrance area, it has a discreet effect and makes narrow rooms appear more open and inviting.
  • Functional integration: it combines clothes hanging, storage, shoe cabinet and decoration in one cabinet and thus covers all the needs of the entrance area. This makes the entrance area smoother and living less tedious and carefree.
  • Note: This product is shipped in two packages and therefore cannot be delivered at the same time. Please make sure that both packages have arrived before the assembly begins!

Descriptions

Descriptions

Total dimensions: 120 x 24 x 200 cm. This wardrobe for the entrance area has 8 hooks and 4 side shelves for displaying photos, decorative items or keys. Additionally, it offers 6 fold-out shoe cabinets with 2 shelves each, ideally accommodating 2 pairs of shoes per shelf (actual capacity may vary depending on availability). A large storage area is also available. The design is white, the cabinets are made of chipboard.
